'''Laura Chaubard''' (born 1980)<ref>{{Cite web |last=Poncet |first=Guerric |date=22 October 2022 |title=Laura Chaubard, de l’IA à l’X |trans-title=Laura Chaubard, from AI to X |url=https://www.lepoint.fr/sciences-nature/laura-chaubard-de-l-ia-a-l-x-22-10-2022-2494850_1924.php |work=[[Le Point]] |language=fr}}</ref> is a French mathematician and the Director General of the [[École polytechnique]],<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.polytechnique.edu/en/news/laura-chaubard-new-director-general-ecole-polytechnique |title=Laura Chaubard, New Director General Of École Polytechnique – Ecole Polytechnique}}</ref> the first woman to hold this position at the [[Grandes écoles|engineering school]]. She is also the interim chair of the school's board of directors since 2023.

== Education and career ==
Laura Chaubard joined the [[École polytechnique]] in 1999. She received a [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD]] in mathematics in 2007 from [[Paris Diderot University]] working on Algebraic methods for formal languages under the supervision of [[Jean-Éric Pin]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Chaubard |first=Laura |date=2007-01-01 |title=Méthodes algébriques pour les langages formels : applications à la logique et à la dynamique symbolique |url=https://www.theses.fr/2007PA077058 |access-date=2024-03-03}}</ref>

In 2006, she joined the French [[Direction générale de l'armement|Directorate General of Armament]] (DGA) as an expert in [[artificial intelligence]], where she notably contributed to the organization of the ESTER 2 campaign for evaluating several automatic analysis systems (transcription, segmentation, named entity recognition) of audio documents in French. Becoming the information system architect for intelligence in 2010, she was appointed in February 2013 as the head of the strategic SME office, and then responsible for budget programming from January to August 2017, always at the DGA.

On August 28, 2017, Laura Chaubard was appointed innovation advisor to the office of the French [[Minister of the Armed Forces (France)|Minister of the Armed Forces]], [[Florence Parly]]. She notably contributed to the creation of the Définvest fund, an investment fund aimed at supporting strategic companies for the defense sector in France.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Perroud |first=Marion |date=2023-10-02 |title=Qui est Laura Chaubard, la nouvelle patronne de l'Ecole Polytechnique? |url=https://www.challenges.fr/femmes/qui-est-laura-chaubard-la-nouvelle-patronne-de-l-ecole-polytechnique_869293 |access-date=2024-03-03 |website=Challenges |language=fr}}</ref>

During the French Council of Ministers on October 5, 2022, she was appointed Director General of the [[École Polytechnique]], becoming the first woman to hold this position.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Forgar |first=Ségolène |date=15 May 2025 |title=Laura Chaubard, directrice de Polytechnique : «La France est une grande nation de mathématiques, mais il faut revoir notre manière de les enseigner en primaire» |trans-title=Laura Chaubard, Director of Polytechnique: “France is a great nation of mathematics, but we need to review the way we teach it in primary school.” |url=https://madame.lefigaro.fr/business/actu-business/laura-chaubard-directrice-de-polytechnique-la-france-est-une-grande-nation-de-mathematiques-mais-il-faut-revoir-notre-maniere-de-les-enseigner-au-primaire-20250515 |work=[[Madame Figaro]] |language=fr}}</ref> On September 17, 2023, she was appointed acting chair of the Board of Directors of the École Polytechnique.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Perroud |first=Marion |date=2023-09-27 |title=Thierry Coulhon et Laura Chaubard nommés à la tête de Polytechnique |trans-title=Thierry Coulhon and Laura Chaubard appointed to head Polytechnique |url=https://www.challenges.fr/grandes-ecoles/thierry-coulhon-et-laura-chaubard-nommes-a-la-tete-de-polytechnique_868625 |access-date=2025-08-11 |website=Challenges |language=fr}}</ref>
